title: Skin Care for Lucknow Weather: A Routine for Loo, Monsoon and Foggy Winters
ex: Hot dusty summers, a humid monsoon and cold, foggy winters: a simple skin care routine for people living in Lucknow, season by season.
rt: Skin Care for Lucknow Weather: Season Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Lucknow weather: sun and dust in loo season, light monsoon care, heaters and dry skin in foggy winters, smog and hard water, kept simple.
quick: Lucknow has very hot, dusty summers, a humid monsoon and cold, foggy winters, so the routine should change with the season. A gentle face wash, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning, light textures from April to September and richer moisturising from November to February suit most people.
facts: Lucknow has a humid subtropical climate
April to June is very hot, with dry hot winds (loo)
The monsoon runs roughly July to September
December and January are cold and often foggy
